children: The Dutch State Treasury Agency will launch a new January 2048-dated government bond, or DSL, via a Dutch Direct Auction on Sept. 29, it said Wednesday.

The DSTA will aim to issue between 5 billion euros and 6 billion euros ($5.80 billion to $6.96 billion) in the new bond, it said. It will use Germany's 3.40% May 2047 Bund as pricing reference, it said.
The DSTA will announce the coupon of the new DSL on Sept. 25 and will announce the initial spread guidance on Sept. 28.
ABN Amro, Morgan Stanley and Bank of America have been appointed as advisors for the DDA.
